package.name: so101_depth_demo
package.description: CPU-capable Depth Anything V2 (Small) monocular depth visualization demo for the SO-101. Extracted from the snap-twin Jetson/TensorRT demo and reworked to subscribe to ROS image topics and run with ONNX Runtime. The execution provider is configurable: CPU by default (no NVIDIA required), or TensorRT/CUDA on an NVIDIA Jetson via the ai-vision-ros2 snap's NVIDIA variant (snap/snapcraft.yaml on the nvidia/ai-demo branch; see docs/ai_vision_ros2_nvidia.md).
